{{Portal|Mathematics}}
'''10,000,000,000,000''' ('''ten trillion''' on the short scale; '''ten billion''' on the long scale; ten thousand [[1,000,000,000|billion]]; ten million [[1,000,000|million]]) is the [[natural number]] following [[1,000,000,000,000#9,000,000,000,000 to 9,999,999,999,999|9,999,999,999,999]] and preceding 10,000,000,000,001. It is known as 10000 arab, 100 kharab, 10 [[lakh]] [[crore]], or 1 '''nil''' in the Indian numbering system.

== Properties and usage ==
10,000,000,000,000 has the following properties and usage:
=== In mathematics ===
*It is [[Even number|even]], [[Composite number|composite]], [[Abundant number|abundant]], [[Polite number|polite]], [[Practical number|practical]], [[Frugal number|frugal]], and [[Regular number|regular]]. It is also a [[perfect power]] and a [[harshad number]].
*It is written in scientific notation as '''1 × 10<sup>13</sup>''' or '''10<sup>13</sup>''' ('''1E+13''' or simply '''1E13''' in [[Scientific notation#E notation|E notation]]).
*It has a total of 196 divisors (182 even, 14 odd). All divisors are displayed below:
<blockquote><small>1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 64, 80, 100, 125, 128, 160, 200, 250, 256, 320, 400, 500, 512, 625, 640, 800, 1000, 1024, 1250, 1280, 1600, 2000, 2048, 2500, 2560, 3125, 3200, 4000, 4096, 5000, 5120, 6250, 6400, 8000, 8192, 10000, 10240, 12500, 12800, 15625, 16000, 20000, 20480, 25000, 25600, 31250, 32000, 40000, 40960, 50000, 51200, 62500, 64000, 78125, 80000, 100000, 102400, 125000, 128000, 156250, 160000, 200000, 204800, 250000, 256000, 312500, 320000, 390625, 400000, 500000, 512000, 625000, 640000, 781250, 800000, 1000000, 1024000, 1250000, 1280000, 1562500, 1600000, 1953125, 2000000, 2500000, 2560000, 3125000, 3200000, 3906250, 4000000, 5000000, 5120000, 6250000, 6400000, 7812500, 8000000, 9765625, 10000000, 12500000, 12800000, 15625000, 16000000, 19531250, 20000000, 25000000, 25600000, 31250000, 32000000, 39062500, 40000000, 48828125, 50000000, 62500000, 64000000, 78125000, 80000000, 97656250, 100000000, 125000000, 128000000, 156250000, 160000000, 195312500, 200000000, 244140625, 250000000, 312500000, 320000000, 390625000, 400000000, 488281250, 500000000, 625000000, 640000000, 781250000, 800000000, 976562500, 1000000000, 1220703125, 1250000000, 1562500000, 1600000000, 1953125000, 2000000000, 2441406250, 2500000000, 3125000000, 3200000000, 3906250000, 4000000000, 4882812500, 5000000000, 6250000000, 7812500000, 8000000000, 9765625000, 10000000000, 12500000000, 15625000000, 16000000000, 19531250000, 20000000000, 25000000000, 31250000000, 39062500000, 40000000000, 50000000000, 62500000000, 78125000000, 80000000000, 100000000000, 125000000000, 156250000000, 200000000000, 250000000000, 312500000000, 400000000000, 500000000000, 625000000000, 1000000000000, 1250000000000, 2000000000000, 2500000000000, 5000000000000, 10000000000000</small></blockquote>
*The sum of all its divisors, including itself, is 24,998,474,116,998.
*It has an [[Euler's totient function|Euler totient]] of 4,000,000,000,000, and an [[aliquot sum]] of 14,998,474,116,998.
*There are a total of 346,065,536,839 positive [[prime number|prime]]s less than it.<ref name=A006880>{{Cite OEIS|A006880|Number of primes less than 10^n}}</ref>

=== In economy ===
[[File:10_Trillion_Zimbabwean_Dollars_(cropped).jpg|200px|thumb|10 trillion Zimbabwean Dollars (2008)]]
*10,000,000,000,000 was used in [[Banknotes of Zimbabwe#2008 banknote issues|Banknotes of Zimbabwe: 2008 banknote series]] circulated due to the intense [[hyperinflation in Zimbabwe]] during the 2008-2009 period.
*39,375,254,020,492 dollars of US debt as of July 5, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fiscal Data Explains the National Debt |url=https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov/americas-finance-guide/national-debt/ |access-date=2026-07-06 |website=fiscaldata.treasury.gov |language=en}}</ref>
